name: Nature's Mod
description: A complete overhaul of nature: towering mountains, rivers and waterfalls, giant trees that topple when chopped; 71 new sea creatures, living reefs, diving suits and the Abyss, a sea a thousand blocks deep beneath the oceans with a mission to uncover, twelve guardian bosses on the way down and 55 kinds of treasure-filled ruins, vaults and wonders at the bottom; and a taller, hellish Nether of brimstone, flesh and bone, vast caverns and infernal citadels.
